title: Ask my AI about the pipeline file, then apply its proposal safely
goal: Give an AI the right context for the pipeline definition in wind-platform, then bring its proposed change back without breaking anything.
hints: Right-click the file: Copy Context for My AI
The AI view imports a proposal
expected: The copied pack names the file, its component and the selected variant
The pack holds no secret-looking value
A valid proposal is shown as a reviewable change before anything is written
A proposal made against an older revision is refused with a readable reason
